text:
lee: RFC follow-up for cutover playbook: migrating customers from shared-peer mesh to per-tenant ephemeral relays. main constraints: preserve client src IP when possible, avoid lease exhaustion on traffic spikes, quick rollback path. need step-by-step operator checklist + exact commands.

rachel: +1. include a preflight validator that checks customer SNAT preferences and active long-lived sessions. also capture audit id on every op.

lee: proposed minimal checklist: 1) preflight checks 2) reserve relay leases 3) warm relays (health probes + certs) 4) shadow 5% traffic 5) promote with sticky leases + optional refresh 6) monitor + reclaim. keep each step reversible.

kai: preflight commands (examples):
```bash
# check snat policy and long sessions
opsctl customer inspect --customer=cust-777 --fields=snat_policy,active_sessions --ticket=INC-2026-9001
```

rachel: reserve leases command:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://ops.internal/egress/v1/leases -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" -d '{"customer":"cust-777","count":30,"region":"eu-central-1","purpose":"cutover-2026-03"}'
```

kai: warm-up probe example:
```bash
opsctl relay create --name=rel-euc-42 --region=eu-central-1 --customer=cust-777 --ticket=INC-2026-9001
opsctl relay probe --relay=rel-euc-42 --customer=cust-777 --shots=200
```

devops-bot: NOTE: relay rel-euc-42 created, probe_results=197/200, health=OK.

lee: shadow traffic: set sample rate low (2-5%). command:
```bash
opsctl route modify --customer=cust-777 --target=rel-euc-42 --sample=3 --ticket=INC-2026-9001
```

mira: monitor metrics: egress.lease_pool_available, relay.health, cp.api_latency, tcp.session_abort_rate. sampling window 10-20m. alert threshold: lease_pool_available < 12% -> autoscale hook.

kai: promote when stable. promotion command with sticky TTL and audit tag:
```bash
opsctl route promote --customer=cust-777 --target=rel-euc-42 --sticky-ttl=1800 --ticket=INC-2026-9001
```

lee: note on sticky ttl: default 1800s for apps that may have websockets. if customer is short-request oriented we can use 600s. for long sessions we enable lease-refresh endpoint so relay can ping to extend.

kai: lease-refresh ping example:
```bash
# relay -> operator extends lease if active
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/egress/v1/leases/refresh -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELAY_TOKEN" -d '{"lease_id":"lease-abc123","extend_seconds":1800}'
```

rachel: rollback plan (fast):
1) disable promotion: `opsctl route rollback --customer=cust-777 --to=shared-peering --ticket=INC-2026-9001`
2) scale operator controllers up if lease exhaustion observed: `kubectl -n infra scale deployment/egress-operator --replicas=$(($(kubectl get deploy egress-operator -o jsonpath='{.status.availableReplicas}')+3))`
3) mark relays CORDON if unhealthy and create replacements.

lee: automation rules: lease_pool_available < 12% -> trigger autoscale + reduce sample rate to 0-1% while ops investigates. eviction policy: prefer non-sticky, short TTL leases first.

mira: audit: every opsctl/curl must include `--ticket=` or `-H "X-Audit-Ticket: <INC>"`. save route ids to customer timeline. auditors will query timeline.

devops-bot: ALERT: lease_pool_available for cust-777 at 11% (threshold 12%). triggered INC-2026-9001. assigned to kai.

kai: I'm doing the autoscale now in staging and will run the warm probe again before we promote further. will update the ticket with commands executed.

lee: good. action items: kai -> implement lease-refresh endpoint + tests, rachel -> add preflight validator to opsctl, mira -> add autoscale alert binding. I'll draft the operator playbook and attach the exact commands to the RFC reply. keep replies short.
